bio: Neeraja Kumar First-Year Social Committee Oak Yard Hello! My name is Neeraja Kumar and I am from Villa Park, Illinois(a suburb in Chicagoland). I am a first-year living in Thayer and I plan on concentrating in either Government or Applied Math. Outside of FYSC, I am involved with WHRB, College Events Board, and MSO. If you see me, it’ll probably be me running to get somewhere because I am late. In my free time, I love checking out new bookstores and antique malls around the Cambridge/Boston area. I am excited to be part of some of our first-year fun! Feel free to say hi if you see me around!
